map.客厅地毯养护周期示例: Living room carpet maintenance cycle example
map.：日常吸尘每周 2 次，饮料泼洒等局部污渍即时处理，深度清洗每 3-6 个月一次: : routine vacuuming twice a week, local spills such as drinks handled immediately, deep cleaning every 3–6 months; after cleaning air and dry about 24 hours before walking on it.
map.深度清洗后多久能干透？: How long does it take to dry after deep cleaning?
map.通风良好约 24-48 小时，潮湿季节或厚绒地毯更久；未干透前走动会留水印并易霉: With good ventilation about 24–48 hours; humid seasons or thick pile carpets take longer, and walking on it before dry leaves water marks and invites mildew.
map.整块地毯能机洗吗？: Can a whole carpet be machine-washed?
map.小块可机洗垫，大面积满铺地毯建议专业设备抽洗，机洗易缩水变形且难彻底脱水。: Small mats can be machine-washed, but large wall-to-wall carpet is best extracted with professional equipment — machine washing shrinks and distorts it and cannot fully spin out water.
map.宠物尿渍怎么处理？: How do you handle pet urine stains?
map.先用纸吸干、再用酶类清洁剂分解蛋白除味，避免用氨水（气味类似尿会诱导再次乱尿），: Blot with paper first, then use an enzymatic cleaner to break down protein and remove the odour; avoid ammonia water (the urine-like smell can trigger another accident), and dry thoroughly afterwards.
